_comment: Option C — explicit dim per value. Shown for comparison only. Rejected: bloats payload, duplicates field-name semantics.
_byteCostNote: Each measurement adds ~15–20 bytes for 'dim'. With ~15 measurements/HBT × 12 HBT/min × 1440 min/day × 365 days = ~470 MB/machine/year of constant redundant strings. Dimension is already implied by field name; this is duplication.
_compareAgainstSchemaBound: Option B achieves the same validation power with 0 payload cost — the dimension is in the schema, not the message.
